steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Always write the formula first, then substitute values, then give the answer with units — this secures method marks even if the final answer is wrong. | Key Fact: Ohm's Law: V = IR can be rearranged to I = V/R or R = V/I depending on which quantity is unknown. | Key Fact: Power formulas: P = VI, P = I²R, P = V²/R — choose the one using the two known quantities. | Key Fact: For potential dividers: V_out = V_in × R2/(R1 + R2); always identify which resistor is R2 (the one V_out is measured across).
